== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of Light Repeating Blaster Rifle with the bronze errata disc, from the starwarsccg.org card lists; this file is the earliest archived copy, uploaded unchanged: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160807181124/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/lightrepeatingblasterrifle.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Light Repeating Blaster Rifle (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].
